posts.name: Birendra paul
posts.cooked:
I am currently setting up a Linux virtual machine on my Windows laptop as per the course instructions. I noticed that the lecture notes and screenshots refer to Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, but the latest available version on the Ubuntu website is Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.

I wanted to confirm which version we should use for the virtual machine setup:

  • Should we strictly use Ubuntu 20.04 LTS to match the lecture notes and lab instructions?

  • Or is it acceptable to use a newer version like Ubuntu 24.04 LTS?

I want to ensure that my setup matches the expected environment for labs, assignments, and evaluations.

posts.name: Subhradeep Bhowmik
posts.cooked: Use the current LTS (long term support) version, i.e., Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.

posts.name: Ashish Khattri
posts.cooked: If you simply install without specifying the version it will automatically pick the latest version. Watch this week’s tutorial to see how to install ubuntu on WSL without installing slow and heavy VMware.

posts.name: Mayank Poddar
posts.cooked:
Any version of Ubuntu will work for it.
Ubuntu on WSL would work too. I didn’t use any Virtual Machine when I’d taken it.
